positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Develop and maintain microservices for an employment background check system. It is API driven, can be integrated with any third-party application, and designed to be a scalable solution for large enterprises. Notable customers include Amazon, Uber, Lyft, DoorDash, Netflix, and Instacart. 
- Lead projects creating new document rejection workflows for criminal screenings. Working with multiple teams from different departments, such as customer support, finance, sales, and legal. 
- Lead projects automating manual workflows for customer support. Reducing operations cost and increasing efficiency of overall background screening process. 
- Analyze and improve architectural design of ticketing microservice, reducing overall traffic, data usage, and service failures.
- Improve and manage CI/CD pipelines for multiple microservices, decreasing total runtime, additional testing for improved stability, and increase efficiency of runners. 
- Lead incidents caused by system failures and developed resolutions to prevent further failures. 
- Improve failure and incident detections for multiple microservices. 
- Conduct data analysis on the impact of new features and cost improvement projects. 
- Serve as a technical lead for multiple microservices, mentor junior developers, design coding interviews, and participate in company improvement projects such as Hackathon.
positions.insights: Ruby, Ruby on Rails and +37 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Develop and maintain K–12 administrative software packages involving Student Management, Human Resources, Financial Management, Food Service and Special Education.
- Lead architectural design and data modeling for application upgrade workflows.
- Lead projects involving creation of in-house Agile Project Board web application.
- Develop a scalable microservice which converts databases for older applications.
- Develop and maintain various websites and backend services for internal and customer use, such as databases, API endpoints, file system, and notifications.
- Integrate third party applications to improve performance of existing applications.
- Conduct data analysis on the impact of new features, sales trend, and company performance.
- Develop a source control application for internal reports. Able to import/export to a database, check in/out, revert, compare, and search documents and its contents.
- Serve as a technical lead for company data analytics, mentor and manage junior developers, and manage deployments of new features.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Develop an application which incorporates any elastic textile and Microsoft Kinect to assist patients suffering from Muscular Dystrophy with their physical therapy.
- Develop an application which organizes large number of files native to the institution. It parses information and saves important test data to the database.
- Manage a large computer network and automated software installation.
- Maintain and develop databases used in internal web applications. 
- Gain experience working with many development techniques in team projects, ranging from Waterfall Development to Agile Development.
